PROJECT CONTEXT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Project: Personal Learning Assistant
Stack: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Capacitor + Android
Type: Offline study app for university exams
Purpose: Enable offline quiz, flashcard, and summary sessions

KEY COMPONENTS MATCHED:
  ✓ React + TypeScript development patterns
  ✓ Vitest testing framework
  ✓ Component-based architecture with hooks
  ✓ IndexedDB persistence layer
  ✓ Mobile app deployment (Android)
  ✓ CSS-in-JS theming system

DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOWS ENABLED
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

🚀 WORKFLOW 1: Rapid Onboarding
   @copilot #acquire-codebase-knowledge → Understand project layout
   @copilot #code-tour → Walk through key components
   @copilot #architecture-blueprint-generator → Visualize flows
   
   Result: New developers productive in 1 hour vs 1 day

🏗️  WORKFLOW 2: New Feature Development
   @copilot #acquire-codebase-knowledge → Find similar patterns
   @copilot #react18-batching-patterns → Optimize performance
   @copilot #javascript-typescript-jest → Generate tests
   @copilot #playwright-generate-test → Create E2E tests
   @copilot #security-review → Audit before merge
   
   Result: Complete feature with full test coverage

🔧 WORKFLOW 3: Refactoring Sprint
   @copilot #architecture-blueprint-generator → Visualize current state
   @copilot #context-map → Understand dependencies
   @copilot #refactor → Get improvement suggestions
   @copilot #javascript-typescript-jest → Generate tests
   @copilot #security-review → Validate changes
   
   Result: Safe, well-tested refactoring

🧪 WORKFLOW 4: Testing & Quality
   @copilot #javascript-typescript-jest → Generate unit tests
   @copilot #playwright-generate-test → Generate E2E tests
   @copilot #quality-playbook → Verify standards
   @copilot #security-review → Check security
   
   Result: High coverage, standards-compliant code

📚 WORKFLOW 5: Documentation Sprint
   @copilot #code-tour → Understand features
   @copilot #architecture-blueprint-generator → Create diagrams
   @copilot #context-map → Document dependencies
   @copilot #documentation-writer → Generate content
   
   Result: Complete, current documentation

🔒 WORKFLOW 6: Security Audit
   @copilot #security-review → Identify vulnerabilities
   @copilot #refactor → Apply fixes
   @copilot #javascript-typescript-jest → Add security tests
   
   Result: Hardened, tested code

🎯 WORKFLOW 7: Code Review Preparation
   @copilot #quality-playbook → Check standards
   @copilot #security-review → Find issues
   @copilot #refactor → Improve code
   @copilot #architecture-blueprint-generator → Verify design
   
   Result: PR ready for smooth reviews

🏃 WORKFLOW 8: Performance Optimization
   @copilot #react18-batching-patterns → Identify React optimizations
   @copilot #context-map → Find bottlenecks
   @copilot #refactor → Implement improvements
   
   Result: Faster, more efficient app

🧠 WORKFLOW 9: Technical Debt Reduction
   @copilot #architecture-blueprint-generator → Visualize issues
   @copilot #refactor → Plan improvements
   @copilot #javascript-typescript-jest → Add safety tests
   
   Result: Better codebase health

⚙️  WORKFLOW 10: Custom Workflow Definition
   @copilot #create-llms → Define new custom instruction
   → Specialized prompts for domain-specific tasks
   
   Result: Tailored Copilot behaviors for project needs


HOW TO USE
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. OPEN COPILOT CHAT
   Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+I (or click Copilot icon)
   
2. REFERENCE A SKILL BY NAME
   @copilot #skill-name Your question or request
   
   Examples:
   • @copilot #acquire-codebase-knowledge What's in the hooks folder?
   • @copilot #refactor How can I improve this component?
   • @copilot #javascript-typescript-jest Generate tests for this
   • @copilot #security-review Check this code for vulnerabilities
   
3. COMBINE MULTIPLE SKILLS
   Use multiple skills in sequence for powerful workflows:
   
   "First, use #acquire-codebase-knowledge to find similar patterns,
    then #react18-batching-patterns to optimize, and finally
    #javascript-typescript-jest to generate tests."

4. AUTO-INVOCATION
   Skills automatically activate when:
   - You're editing certain file types
   - Your question matches skill keywords
   - You're working in specific project directories
